# Lifecycle Plus Status Prose

Lifecycle: active
Role: spec
Project: demo
Status: Implementation in progress; F0 rename pending Phase 5.
Updated: 2026-05-24

A doc with both a `Lifecycle:` controlled-vocab line and a free-form
`Status:` prose line. Post-F0, `Status:` is no longer the controlled key,
so the prose is a non-required extra field and `docs check` must accept
the doc.
